title: The Bait
note: Ensemble episode — all six DSK characters. Seedance 2.5 reference-to-video generates this as ONE continuous 30s take (not stitched clips), which is what keeps the characters consistent across the whole runtime. Reference order below defines @Image1..@Image6.
prompt:
A warm, cinematic 3D-animated cartoon short for children, one continuous scene inside a glowing blue digital castle courtyard made of soft light and floating data. Bright, friendly, Pixar-like lighting. Nothing scary or graphic.

@Image1 is Sir Shieldy, a golden knight mascot — calm leader. @Image2 is Pixel, an energetic curious boy. @Image3 is Glitch, a mischievous purple blob trickster. @Image4 is Bot, a small white robot who is confidently wrong. @Image5 is Sprout, a tiny cheerful young sidekick. @Image6 is Dame Noble, a rose-gold girl knight — precise and kind.

ACTION, in one flowing shot: @Image3 Glitch slinks out from behind a pillar and conjures a huge glittering golden popup that reads FREE! ONLY 10 SECONDS LEFT, grinning slyly. @Image2 Pixel's eyes go wide and he reaches toward it, tempted. @Image1 Shieldy steps in and gently lowers Pixel's hand, shaking his head with a warm smile — the popup's countdown flashes urgently. @Image4 Bot rolls in, scans the popup and states flatly that it computes as genuine; @Image6 Dame Noble raises one finger and taps the popup, which pops like a soap bubble revealing it was empty all along — Bot's screen-face blinks in surprise. @Image5 Sprout tugs Shieldy's cape and points up at the fading popup, curious and reassured. @Image3 Glitch deflates, sputters, and fizzles away into harmless purple sparkles. Finally all five heroes stand together in a hero line as their shields light up in unison, forming a bright protective dome.

Camera: slow smooth push-in, then a gentle arc around the group for the final hero shot. Uplifting orchestral music that resolves warmly. No text overlays, no words on screen except the glittering FREE popup.
